sections.name: Hero Section
sections.title: Car Accident Insurance Options in Austin

paras.t: After a crash, your care is usually covered by auto insurance, not health insurance. Here's how each option works, and how we handle it.

sections.name: Intro Section
sections.title: You almost certainly aren't paying for this yourself

paras.t: There are three common ways chiropractic care gets paid for after a car accident: your own PIP coverage, the at-fault driver's insurance, or a letter of protection from your attorney. We handle all three in house.
Tell us what you have, and we'll tell you what it covers before you're treated.

cards.title: PIP (Personal Injury Protection)
cards.text: In Texas, auto policies include at least $2,500 of PIP unless you rejected it in writing. It's your own coverage and it pays for medical care after a crash no matter who caused it. It can cover your passengers too.

cards.title: The at-fault driver's insurance
cards.text: If someone else caused the crash, their liability coverage pays for your treatment. These claims usually pay when the case settles, not visit by visit, which is why we track the documentation for you along the way.

cards.title: Letter of protection (LOP)
cards.text: If you have an attorney, they can send us a letter of protection. You get treated now, and the bill is paid from your settlement. No money up front.

sections.name: Health Insurance Section
sections.title: We don't bill health insurance for car accidents

paras.t: Car accident care runs through auto insurance or your claim, not your health plan.
If none of the options above apply to you, we'll tell you that up front and walk you through what care would cost before anything starts.

faqs.a: In most cases, no. PIP, a letter of protection, or a third-party claim usually covers it. We'll confirm which applies to you before treatment starts.

faqs.q: What if the crash was my fault?
faqs.a: Your own PIP still applies. It pays regardless of who caused the crash.

faqs.q: Do I need an attorney to be seen?
faqs.a: No. You can be seen without one. If you already have an attorney, we'll work with their office on documentation.

faqs.q: Is PIP my own coverage or the other driver's?
faqs.a: Your own. It pays for medical care after a crash no matter who caused it, so you don't have to wait on the other driver's insurance to get treated.

faqs.q: How soon can I be seen?
faqs.a: Often the same day. Call and tell us you were in an accident.
